nights.title: Seb Lowe
nights.name: Seb Lowe
nights.extract: Sebastian Lowe is an English singer-songwriter from Saddleworth, Greater Manchester. He is known for incorporating politics into his music, having started out uploading videos of his songs to TikTok.

en.who: Sebastian Lowe is an English singer-songwriter from Saddleworth, Greater Manchester. His songs are known for incorporating politics, and he started out uploading videos of them to TikTok.
facts: He is known for incorporating politics into his music.
He started out uploading videos of his songs to TikTok.

tr.kicker: İngiliz şarkıcı-söz yazarı · Saddleworth, Greater Manchester
tr.who: Sebastian Lowe, Greater Manchester'daki Saddleworth'den gelen İngiliz bir şarkıcı-söz yazarıdır. Şarkılarında siyaseti işlemesiyle bilinir ve TikTok'a şarkılarının videolarını yükleyerek başladı.

nights.title: Jesse & Joy
nights.name: Jesse & Joy
nights.extract: Jesse & Joy is a Mexican pop duo. It was formed in 2005 in Mexico City by brother and sister Jesse and Joy Huerta.

en.kicker: Mexican pop duo · formed 2005 in Mexico City
